description: Download a trailer file. Prefers steamMp4Url (direct publisher asset, lowest copyright risk); otherwise yt-dlp on ytId/url. Returns { filePath, bytes, source }. Pass filePath to youtube_upload. [requires yt-dlp + ffmpeg on the host for the YouTube fallback path].

appid.description: Steam appid — used only to name the output file.

filename.description: Base output filename (without extension). Defaults derived from ytId/appid.

quality.description: yt-dlp -f format string. Default: best video+audio ≤1080p, merged to mp4.

steamMp4Url.description: Direct Steam mp4 URL (from youtube_source steamMovies[].mp4). Preferred — no yt-dlp/ffmpeg required.

url.description: Explicit video URL to download via yt-dlp.

useCookies.description: Cookie fallback for the yt-dlp path. The server downloads cookieless first and only retries with browser cookies if YouTube demands auth (age/region/members-gated). Defaults on; pass false to hard-disable.

ytId.description: YouTube video id to download via yt-dlp (fallback for YouTube-only trailers).

name: youtube_download
